page.layout: One page of verse in italic, single column; below the last line a catchword "F" at centre-left and a catchword "Illuc" at right.

l.i: Nec non obsessae prope moenia conditur urbis
Sancta fides, pars templa nouant, pars aggere muros
Pars fundare domos, opere omnis Boetica feruet.
Et iam finis erat bello, iam Bobdalis ultro
Ipse habitu vultuque humilis ferrata recludit
Ad latus it, pulcra comitum stipata corona,
Atque animis sexum, curisque viribus implet.
Pone subit procerum in medio Mendozius Heros
Albo inuectus equo, cui sacri insigne senatus
Centum agit errabunda, sacroque interserit ostro,
At circum extremas niuei subtemins oras
Ipsum autem obducto credas transfulgere velo
Hos equitum globus, & peditum manus anteit ingens.

page.notes: The first two lines of the verse are printed with a dropped initial N; the catchwords "F" and "Illuc" are printed at the foot. Some words are blurred by show-through and may be misread, notably "subtemins" and "inamabilis", which are copied as printed.
